#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TRAIN_PID=745668
CHECKPOINT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/acib_v73_connector_lora_seed42"
CHECKPOINT_STEP=20000

echo "[$(date)] Watching PID $TRAIN_PID for LoRA training completion..."

while kill -0 $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 30
done

echo "[$(date)] PID $TRAIN_PID exited. Checking checkpoint..."

if [ -f "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}/checkpoint-${CHECKPOINT_STEP}/checkpoint.pt" ]; then
    echo "[$(date)] checkpoint-${CHECKPOINT_STEP} found. Starting Probe A..."
    cd /root/acib
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /root/miniconda3/bin/python3 -u scripts/cross_task_probe.py \
        --checkpoint_dir "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}/checkpoint-${CHECKPOINT_STEP}" \
        --base_model lerobot/smolvla_libero \
        --dataset_id lerobot/libero \
        --data_root /root/autodl-tmp/libero_dataset \
        --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/v73_eval/probe \
        --device cuda:0
    echo "[$(date)] Probe A completed."
else
    echo "[$(date)] ERROR: checkpoint-${CHECKPOINT_STEP}/checkpoint.pt NOT found!"
    echo "[$(date)] Contents of ${CHECKPOINT_DIR}:"
    ls -la "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}/" 2>/dev/null || echo "Directory not found"
fi
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/acib/watch_lora_and_probe.sh
